summary.control_station_rule: For each original short ray and selected root: outside; just inside entry; just inside exit; just after exit; 1,10,25,50,75,90,99 percent of first span and next finite geometric interval (or first 1 mm after terminal exit). Full next-interval boundary screening independently covers unbounded intervals to infinity. Boundary positions have no material/air winding assignment.

normal_boundary_screen.comparison: Author single-after-probe candidate screen reported 4 rays among 70800 rays / 10 points per original triangle. Independent whole-interval clipping checks 106200 rays / 15 points per original triangle and finds the same 4 old-stencil rays plus 13 added-stencil rays. The numeric increase is due to expanded sampling, not evidence that 13 were missed within the author 10-point stencil. Whole-interval evidence also preserves every finite triangle segment instead of labeling a whole interval from one probe.

author_nearest_edge_pair_evidence_preser.method: nearest sampled finite dihedral edge, filtered by an adjacent face normal matching source normal; use its adjacent normals bisector

opposing_coplanar_independent.method: Same code on all cases. Expanded original AABB by 1e-6 mm; opposite unit normals dot < -1+1e-9; maximum vertex-to-plane distance <=1e-6 mm. Long-double Sutherland-Hodgman convex clipping on dominant-axis projection, corrected surface area; positive area >1e-9 mm2. No mesh repair, merge, welding, or deletion. Near-coplanarity tolerance is retained explicitly; not all reported positive candidates need be exactly coplanar.
opposing_coplanar_independent.limits: Finite-precision opposing-near-coplanar screen is not a global self-intersection or thickness theorem. No acceptance or exception approved.

summary.limits: Finite sampled mesh evidence only. Positive root support does not replace a failing original-normal short span, remove the 17 boundary-degenerate original rays, make the author nearest-edge method pass, establish global minimum thickness, or authorize a reviewer exception. No original mesh edits or repairs were performed.
